name: mecha-tag-stats-worker
description: Mecha Tag round telemetry: Cloudflare Worker + D1 ingest, and the private Google-sign-in dashboard.

scripts.db:peek: wrangler d1 execute mecha-tag-stats --remote --command "SELECT hour_utc, map, mode, rounds, hunter_wins, painter_wins, abandoned FROM round_stats ORDER BY hour_utc DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:peek:local: wrangler d1 execute mecha-tag-stats --local --command "SELECT hour_utc, map, mode, rounds, hunter_wins, painter_wins, abandoned FROM round_stats ORDER BY hour_utc DESC LIMIT 20"
